The '''''Aremin''''' was a [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigate]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It was attacked by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Toob Ancher]] while suffering from the last stages of [[Bitter Winter]].<ref name="A Bitter Winter" />
